batting.dismissal: c KA Pollard b R Dhawan

batting.name: DA Miller
batting.dismissal: c NM Coulter-Nile b KA Pollard

batting.name: GJ Maxwell
batting.dismissal: c M Vohra b P Kumar

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: c AC Gilchrist b P Awana

batting.name: Harbhajan Singh
batting.dismissal: c Gurkeerat Singh b AC Gilchrist

balls.text: the off stump goes for a walk! Praveen makes a lot of room and Malinga fires a yorker on the off stump, the stump goes for a toss and lands a few yards back, that's 100 IPL wickets for Malinga

Appeal for a run-out and Chawla is gone! He makes room and puts away a low full toss wide of cover, they risk a second run and Maxwell fires the throw to Karthik, Chawla's bat was in the air, about two storeys high, failed to ground his bat
digs out a yorker to the on side
good shot by Vohra! Malinga bowls it full and outside off, Vohra makes room and scoops it over long-off
fires that on the pads and he fails to put that away
another plumb lbw for Malinga! Hard to put away that full delivery, Gurkeerat was deep at the crease and didn't look in good position to flick that, flush on the base of the pads
he attempts a yorker but it's a low full toss, Miller makes room and checks the lofted shot, travels flat to Coulter-Nile at long-on
tucked it away to the on side
cleverly played! Pollard delivered that from wide of the crease, bowled it short, he was cramped for room but adjusted by opening the face of the bat and gliding it wide of Malinga at short third man
fullish in length on middle and worked to the on side
good placement! Miller was down the track and played an ungainly heave to the deep, bisected two fielders converging at deep midwicket
slower ball outside the off stump and he misses
edgy! Pitches that up outside off and he makes room and he tries to crash that to the off side and gets an outside edge wide of the keeper
good yorker and he can only jam it out back to the bowler
stylishly played! This was fired on the pads and he works his wrists well and clips it away wide of square leg
no century for Mahmood! He missed a full toss on the pads, this was a fast one from Malinga, Mahmood was forward slightly and looked to swing it to the leg side, flush on the knee roll and plumb
makes room and he fails to put it away, the ball rolls down the track
fires that full and he jams it out down to long-off
stays back and he clips it away wide of midwicket
Marsh perishes going for the slog, Harbhajan sensed he was going for it by bowling it flat and quick, swing and a miss and the ball clips the leg stump
full and wide outside off and pushes to the off side
goes bigger! Tossed up and he comes forward and makes room and launches it over wide long-on
spanked! Harbhajan bowled that short and wide outside off, made room and bashed that wide of extra cover
he runs him down to third man
wide outside off and Mahmood made room and left it alone thinking it would be a wide, the bowler and keeper weren't pleased
slower ball and short outside the off stump and he makes room and carves that down to third man
forces it down the ground to long-off and they take the second run
good comeback by the bowler, fires the yorker and Mahmood makes room and can only dig it out softly to the bowler
smokes it hard down to sweeper cover
lovely shot! Pitches that up outside off and Marsh stays at the crease and launches it over the bowler's head and down to long-on
Mahmood is great touch, this was dropped short as well and Mahmood swivels and hooks it over short fine leg, he tried the shot earlier and was dropped
he bowls the slower ball and he drags it a bit too short, rolls the wrists and pulls him hard past square leg and the fielder dives in vain at the deep
fires that full and wide outside off and he has to reach out to drive that wide of cover
makes room and cuts that hard to sweeper on the off side, good work by the fielder
not too short and yet he pulls wide of square leg
fires that yorker down the leg side and he makes room and digs it out wide of the bowler
Dropped again! Now Marsh gets a life, pitched up outside off and he scoops it over the off side and the ball dips towards Harbhajan at long-off and he falls forward and cannot hang on
certainly not his most convincing boundary, short of a length outside off, he made room and swung at it and the outside edge just cleared the keeper
clips his pads but down the leg side, the bowler appeals
drifts on the pads and he clips it towards midwicket
goes back and punches it wide of point
Dropped  by Coulter-Nile! This was short and Mahmood top edge the hook, Coulter-Nile ran backwards from short fine leg, had it covered and spilled it
goes back and punches it wide of backward point to bring up his fifty
6 + 6 + 4! Maxwell is generous with his width and length, short and wide outside off and slapped wide of backward point
two in a row! Tossed up on middle and leg and he bends and slogs over wide long-on this time
that was straight! Tossed up on middle, Mahmood clears the front leg, bends and lofts him over the sight screen
chips down the track and drives him down to long-off to bring up his fifty
goes back and punches it back to the bowler
awkwardly played, he reached forward and scooped it one-handed and luckily for him there was nobody at mid-off
stays behind the line and pushes it on the walk to mid-off
fires that full and wide outside off and he opens the face and squirts it out to third man
bowls the yorker this time outside the off stump and he gets his bat down to try and dig that out
tucks him up for room and he stays back and defends back to the bowler
length delivery on the pads and he clips it wide of mid-on
stays back and works it wide of cover
flatter delivery and he goes back and defends
goes back and knocks it back to the bowler
goes back and clips it down to fine leg
puts away a poor delivery, flatter ball outside off, dropped short and he stays back and bashes it hard wide of cover
tossed up outside the off stump and he comes forward and drives on the up wide of point
pushes it towards mid-off
Pollard feeds him on the pads, another slower ball and he whips away the half volley wide of midwicket
goes back and punches it to the off side
poor delivery, half volley outside the off stump and he bends down and bashes that wide of the covers
slower ball outside the off stump and he drives wide of cover
lands it outside the off stump and he opens the face and runs it down to third man
gets forward and punches it towards mid-off
flatter delivery and he tries to cut and the ball skids through and beats him
flatter delivery and he pushes it wide of point
goes back at the crease and cuts wide of point
flatter delivery and he opens the face and steers it to short third man
outside the off stump and he opens the face and dabs it down to third man
three in a row! This was delicately played, slower ball on the pads and he gently tickles this one down to fine leg, the fielder dives and can't stop it
lovely timing again, this was fired full outside the off stump and he merely pushes it off the meat of the bat and beats Harbhajan who misfields at cover
safer this time, this was fired full outside the off stump and he opens the face of the bat and slices it wide of point
just over fine leg! This was a bouncer and Mahmood went for the hook and the top edge just sailed over the fine leg fielder who tried to catch that one-handed
good yorker, outside the off stump and Mahmood manages to dig it out
fires that too full and wide outside the off stump and he doesn't play a shot
well played! He makes room and waits for the turn and cuts him wide of short third man
makes a lot of room and chops it to the off side
goes on the back foot and pushes it towards cover
goes back and flicks it down to deep midwicket
comes round the wicket, he stays back and punches it hard down to mid-on
tossed up outside off, he rocks back and cuts hard to deep point
goes back at the crease and punches it to mid-off
gets away with a short one, goes back and pulls him down to deep midwicket
three in four balls! Kulkarni bowls it too short, he stays back and pulls him behind square on the on side, beats fine leg
slower delivery and spanked! Gave him width outside off, he waited for it and played a fierce cut wide of backward point
goes back and defends back to the bowler
beats the fielder! Only just, this was a half volley outside off and he merely pushes it through the line and just beats the diving mid-off fielder
keeps it straight again and he knocks it back to the bowler
fullish in length outside off and punched to the off side
he strays down the leg side and wide called
not the most attractive of shots, he fetched that from outside off and heaved it across the line, managed to find the gap at midwicket
stays beside the line and he chops it down towards point
stays back at the crease and punches it to the off side
drifts on the body and he tucks it away down to square leg
gets some good away movement and he pushes it to the off side
good length on the stumps and he stays behind the line and defends
he stays behind the line and pats it to the off side for a single
drifts towards the pads and he works it away wide of midwicket, the ball races away
taps it in front of mid-off and sets off
good delivery, this one kicked up a bit and he awkwardly fended it towards slip
lovely way to get off the mark! This was a half volley outside the off stump, he had the width to crash that wide of the covers

Gilchrist loses his off stump in his last IPL match! Coulter-Nile fires that full and on the off stump, he tries to mow it to the on side, misses and the off stump goes for a flip and lands  a few yards back
crashed! This was full in length on the off stump and he smashes it down the ground and wide of mid-off
keeps it a touch full, he gets forward and pushes it back to the bowler
gets some good inswing again, a touch wide outside off and left alone
soft dismissal! Dhawan pitched it up outside off and Mandeep went for the off drive, ended up spooning it straight to Pollard at mid-off
fullish in length again and he gets forward and knocks it back to the bowler
big swing and a miss! Extra bounce for Rishi, outside the off stump
he gets some good inswing and he comes well forward and clips it to the on side
goes for the leg side swing but it looked like an inside edge to the pads
that was a quick yorker down the leg side and Gilchrist was in a tangle as he tried evading it
just short of a length outside off and he punches it to the off side
bangs it in short and he swivels and pulls him down to fine leg
drifts a bit on the pads and he firmly flicks it towards square leg
bounce straightaway and it beats Gilchrist, he poked his bat out and the ball just moved away

Gilly bowls an innocuous off spinner and he gets a wicket first-ball! Harbhajan slogs one-handed, goes straight down Gurkeerat's throat at long-on, Gilly does the Gangnam! Rather the half Gangnam, charges off, leaps, you should have seen him celebrate!
pushes a yorker down to long-off
another good yorker, outside the off stump and he fails to dig it out
that's a good slower ball, swings and misses it
that was the slower one and he chips it towards mid-on
the off stump is flattened! This was a inswinging yorker, tough to dig those out, Coulter-Nile jams his bat on the pitch and the off stump is down, that's his 200th wicket in T20
slower delivery and he swivels and pulls to the on side
a bit too late in the day, this was a length ball on middle and leg and he swivels and clubs it over deep midwicket
fullish in length outside off and he pushes it to extra cover
another slower ball and he mistimes the pull to mid-on
slower delivery outside off and he chops it to the off side
swings it on the pads and he works it to midwicket
slower delivery outside off and he plays and misses
good length outside off and pushed to mid-off
good inswinging yorker but was that missing leg? Dhawan once again shuffled across to the off stump to slog that away, it was on the base of the pads and it looked like going down leg with the angle
stays back and he punches it to the off side
good slower ball, goes right across to the off stump and attempts a slog but misses
Dhawan tries an AB de Villiers special, goes right across to the off stump and tries to slog him, misses it completely

he's legally caught this time! A hat-trick of catches, this time Sandeep fires a full delivery on middle and leg, Pollard whips it over the on side, travels flat and down to long-on, Miller jogs back and he's in front of the rope
caught at long-off again but it's a Free Hit! Pollard made room and lofted it high and down long-off's throat again
he is caught at long-off but it's a front foot no-ball! It was pitched up and he scooped it flat to long-off
slower delivery and he tries to run this down to third man, the ball bounces towards wide slip
the bowler was unlucky there! He bowled a yorker on the leg stump, the ball hits his pads outside the line of the leg stump and the ball races away to third man
Sandeep comes round the wicket, full on the middle stump and he drills it down to long-on
opens the face of the bat and he runs this down to third man
fires that full on middle and leg and he whips it down to midwicket
full in length outside the off stump and he pushes that wide of cover
shot of intent there! This was short outside off and Dhawan picked the length early and clubbed it flat wide of midwicket
this one swings back in sharply and he manages to dig it out
Pollard lucky to get away this time, fetches one wide outside off and he scoops it one handed down to deep point
has the Pollard shower finally started? This was short and Pollard made room and clubbed it over wide long-on, not his best looking shot but that really travelled, looks like they've lost the ball
opens the face and tries to run it down to third man but can't beat the fielder in the circle
quicker delivery and he shuffles and works it to the leg side
goes for the heave and it's an ungainly shot, inside edge to the on side
drifts on the pads and Pollard does well to work his wrists and clip i down to fine leg
flatter delivery and he commits forward and defends
drifts down the leg side and wide called
tossed up outside off and he pushes it down to cover
short and wide and he looks to cut but misses
more of those will be handy, this was a fraction short, he plays a one-legged pull wide of square leg
chops it towards slip who is standing wide, Mumbai struggling for rune here
nips back in and he is tucked for room, he chops it to the off side
stays back at the crease and he works it towards midwicket
stays back and he punches it down to mid-on
Kings XI are chipping away! Looked like the top spinner, Rohit made room to cut, missed it and the ball clipped the off stump
Chawla bowls the bouncer, well not quite, but it was short, he pulls it wide of midwicket
stays back and punches it to the on side
Dropped! Tossed up outside off and Rohit spooned the drive towards Marsh at cover, he had it covered but the ball spilled out
opens the face and runs it wide of point
quite stylish! Rohit at his best, this was a half volley outside the off stump and he reaches forward and effortlessly pushes it wide of cover
this one nips back in and he clips it to the on side
this was shorter in length and he hops at the crease and defends
bangs it in short and Pollard ducks, close to being called a wide
stays back and he punches it towards mid-on
flatter delivery and he lunges forward and defends
the googly and it tucks him up, hits his pads but down the leg side
flatter delivery and he comes forward and drives back to the bowler
gets a big wicket here! Tossed up outside off and Karthik leans forward and chips it back to the bowler, Kings XI in control with Mumbai 4 down
stays back and pushes it to the off side
start of something big? Tossed up and Rohit stays at the crease and lofts crisply over the sightscreen, into the second tier
tucks him up for room and he chops it towards point
stays back and he defends with soft hands to the off side
he gets him with the short ball! Rayudu swiveled at the crease looking to hook it over fine leg, gets a glove to it and Gilchrist takes the catch
he pitches it up on middle and leg and he launches it over midwicket
he makes room and slaps a length delivery wide of point
good length outside off and he opens the face and runs it down to third man
drifts on the pads and he knocks it wide of square leg
the googly this time, he stays back and knocks it back to the bowler
flatter and quicker and he pushes it to the off side
drives and gets an inside edge to the pads
tossed up on off and middle and he comes well forward and defends
fires that full on the off stump and he drills it down to long-on
good bowling and good running, tucked up for room, places it with soft hands to the off side and sets off quickly
good length on the pads and he works it towards square leg
clips it away behind square on the on side
fires that full and he shuffles and clips it to the on side
cramps him up for room and he pushes it to the off side
stays back and punches it to mid-off
this was the slower delivery bowled short and Rohot fetches that from outside off and pulls behind square on the on side
full outside off and he pushes it to the off side
fuller delivery and he pushes it down to mid-off for a single
Sandeep swings it back in and he overpitches again, fetches it from middle and he chips it over midwicket
Rayudu goes over the top! Pitched up and swinging in, he stays at the crease and lofts down to wide long-on, one bounce and four
stays back and chops it wide of point
chips down the track and he lofts him over midwicket, Praveen gets the ball to move back in
not much room again and he ends up chopping it to point
drifts down the leg side this time, didn't control the swing
PK's inswing to the right-handers is causing problems, tucked for room, he can only place it to point
drifts towards the pads and he knocks it to the leg side
drifts it towards the pads and he works it away down to fine leg, fielder slides and stops it
full outside off and pushed to the off side
what a comeback by the bowler! After getting hit for a six, Sandeep swings this one towards the off stump, Tare goes for the loft but leaves a gap between pad and bat, knocks down the off stump
terrific shot! Length delivery on middle and leg, swings in  and Tare stays at the crease and lofts through the line and over long-on
fullish on the pads and he works it wide of midwicket
nips it back in and he shuffles and whips it away down to deep square leg
drifts on the pads and he chips it in the air over square leg
good comeback by PK, this one nipped back in sharply, he can only chop it down to point
swings it towards the pads and he works it away wide of midwicket and mid-on, well timed
stays beside the line and he steers it down to third man
cramps him up for room and he opens the face and chops it to point
good bowling PK! Moves it away from the right-hander, just beats the edge
keeps it tight and he clips it back to the bowler
stays back at the crease and defends down the track
Mahmood gives him too much width, Tare reaches out and cuts it away wide of backward point
spoke too soon, drops it fractionally too short and Tare swivels and clubs it over midwicket, just carried over the rope
Mahmood's in the middle of a good over, this one drifts in and moves away after pitching, beats the edge
drifts it back in and he places it straight to mid-off
stays beside the line and pushes it to the off side
cramps him up for room and he gets an inside edge to the pads
reaches out and places it to the off side
keeps it outside off and he swings it away, left alone
top edge! Praveen moves it back in and Maxwell goes for the big swing over the on side, gets a thick top edge that swirls to third man
this one swings in as well and he goes for the square drive and misses
swings it back in and he taps it to the off side
